name: Drip
description: Drip is an ecommerce marketing automation platform for subscriber profiles, segmentation, email campaigns, workflows, forms, events, and shopper activity. Merchants use it to coordinate personalized customer journeys and lifecycle marketing.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Drip account through Relay's public-integration OAuth app with the provider's `public` scope and non-expiring access token. Relay exposes only one selected subscriber's ID and timestamps plus bounded metadata for one selected Email Series Campaign; subscriber identity and behavior, other resources, messaging, automation, exports, and mutations are blocked.

credentialRequirements.label: Relay Drip OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-held Relay public-integration client ID configured with the exact callback.

credentialRequirements.name: DRIP_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Relay Drip OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-held Drip client secret; never sent to clients or agents.

credentialRequirements.name: DRIP_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected Drip account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one account used in both fixed API paths.

credentialRequirements.name: DRIP_SUBSCRIBER_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected non-email subscriber ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The opaque subscriber ID whose ID and timestamps Relay may read; email selectors are rejected.

credentialRequirements.name: DRIP_CAMPAIGN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected Email Series Campaign ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one Email Series Campaign whose bounded summary Relay may read.

capabilities.label: Read selected subscriber summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and timestamps for one selected subscriber without identity, contact, consent, status, activity, score, value, tags, IP, purchase, or custom fields.

capabilities.label: Read selected Email Series Campaign summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded organizational metadata for one selected Email Series Campaign.

allowed.label: Read selected subscriber summary
allowed.description: Read the selected subscriber's ID and timestamps while discarding all personal and marketing fields.

allowed.label: Read selected Email Series Campaign summary
allowed.description: Read the selected Email Series Campaign's ID, name, status, and creation time while discarding sender, notification, subscriber, form, link, and message details.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Subscriber identity, contact, consent, status, activity, score, value, tags, custom, purchase, and IP fields plus campaign sender, notification, subscriber, form, and link data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Drip state
blocked.description: Subscriber changes, subscriptions, tags, events, campaigns, workflows, forms, webhooks, shopper activity, sends, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Drip access
blocked.description: Other accounts, subscribers, campaigns, users, lists, searches, pages, workflows, conversions, events, arbitrary paths, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected subscriber and Email Series Campaign through an account-bound Relay OAuth grant; private data, broader access, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway stores the non-expiring Relay-owned Drip OAuth token server-side and mounts exactly two account-bound projected reads.

providerSetup.blocker: A Drip public-integration OAuth app, exact Railway callback, provider-issued client credentials, authorized staging account, opaque subscriber ID, Email Series Campaign ID, and live grant are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console lane must register and activate Relay's public Drip OAuth app with the exact Railway callback, capture the client credentials in Railway, authorize a staging account, bind an opaque subscriber ID and Email Series Campaign ID, then validate account isolation, both redacted reads, email-selector denial, rate and authorization errors, token revocation by uninstall, replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Drip documents an HTTPS JSON API at api.getdrip.com, private API-token authentication, public-integration OAuth bearer authentication, app registration with an exact callback, the public scope, and non-expiring OAuth tokens.
Drip documents GET /v2/:account_id/subscribers/:id_or_email_or_visitor_uuid and the sensitive subscriber fields excluded by Relay; Relay permits only an opaque ID selector.
Drip documents GET /v2/:account_id/campaigns/:campaign_id, its single-campaign envelope, and the Email Series Campaign metadata used for Relay's bounded projection.
Drip documents 3,600 individual requests per hour, 429 rate responses, and safe 401, 403, 404, and 422 error semantics.
